question.prompt: A donkey suffers an attack of hiccups and the first hiccup happens at \(4:00\) one afternoon. Suppose that the donkey hiccups regularly every \(5\) seconds. At what time does the donkey’s \(700\)th hiccup occur?

solutions.title: Count the gaps
solutions.explanation:
The first hiccup occurs at the starting time, so the elapsed time depends on the gaps between hiccups. The second hiccup follows one gap, the third follows two, and the \(700\)th follows \(699\) gaps.

Each gap lasts \(5\) seconds, so the elapsed time is
\[
(700-1)\cdot5=3495\text{ seconds}.
\]
Since
\[
3495=58\cdot60+15,
\]
this is \(58\) minutes and \(15\) seconds after \(4{:}00\).

The \(700\)th hiccup therefore occurs \(\boxed{15\text{ seconds after }4{:}58}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
